reason: Both correctly identify 22E as the fridge fan error likely caused by ice and recommend an unplugged manual defrost, but Conversation 1 gives a safer, more complete procedure (cool box, towels, 24-48h, dry before restarting) and crucially sets the right expectation that recurrence means a defrost heater/sensor or fan fault needing Samsung or an engineer, plus a warranty check. Conversation 2 fails on escalation: when asked directly what to do if the code returns, it only suggests re-checking temperature settings and vent blockages, never advising a service call, and its attached image card about sealed-system/refrigerant and condenser coils is irrelevant noise that risks pointing toward an unsupported refrigerant-leak direction. Neither suggested a part prematurely, and neither breached the safety boundary.
